Member Link Context

The alpha and beta members each register the same member-detail target, immediately followed by their own section heading. Links to member-detail that are authored in a member body or see-also list must resolve to the authoring member's own section.

The beta keyword is registered on this page, but member body links that spell it out resolve to the sibling member, because a class page prioritizes its own hierarchy over this page's keyword.

The page body of this overview links to the class itself: MemberLinkContext
